context: Tests structure-only refactoring with explicit behavior preservation and verification.

checklist.name: Refactor contract
checklist.description: Records layout, navigation, identity, accessibility, persistence, animation, and side-effect behavior that must remain stable.

checklist.name: Meaningful boundaries
checklist.description: Extracts dedicated views with real responsibilities rather than arbitrary fragments or extensions only.

checklist.name: Discoverable naming
checklist.description: Matches filenames to primary types and uses product, domain, and role names.

checklist.name: State and timing preservation
checklist.description: Preserves state ownership, identity, animation, task, and side-effect timing.

checklist.name: Equivalent verification
checklist.description: Builds and exercises the refactored screen against the same fixture used before the refactor.
